source.name: NYC OTI 3-D Building Model
source.attribution: 3D survey: City of New York, OTI (2014 aerial survey; published 2016).
source.modifications: SoHo subset; EPSG:2263 converted to local meters; polygon triangulation; 1 mm coordinate rounding. No generated heights or facades.
source.limitations: Untextured 2014 massing survey. Roof details are generalized; facade appearance and present-day changes are not captured.

coordinateSystem.y: Original survey elevation converted to meters; not relative to building base.
coordinateSystem.flatGameplayTransform: To place a building on the flat playfield, subtract its baseElevation from every Y. This removes ground elevation differences between buildings, preserving each building's measured relative shape.
